function.name: list_products
function.description: List store products, optionally filtered by keyword or category.

keyword.description: A word or phrase to search for in product names, descriptions, or categories.

category.description: An exact product category such as Kitchen, Travel, Home, Home Office, or Stationery.

function.name: get_product_details
function.description: Get the complete catalog details for one product.

function.name: place_order
function.description: Place an order for an in-stock product after the application has confirmed the product, quantity, and price with the customer.

quantity.description: The number of units to order.

function.name: get_order_status
function.description: Look up the status of an existing order by its order number.

orderNumber.description: The order number supplied by the customer.
